text:
kai: Hi team — opened my very first PR for the model-proxy healthcheck (branch feat/model-proxy/healthcheck, ticket INF-7). Quick orientation: do we want a single commit or keep iteration history? Also what's the minimal PR body you want?

ana: Welcome kai! :wave: Iterate however you like while working, but we prefer a single logical commit on main. If it helps reviewers, keep a separate `chore(format)` commit for auto fixes. PR body: ticket link, 1-line summary, How to test (commands), and Risk.

tj: For commit messages we use `area(scope): short summary`, e.g., `proxy(health): add liveness endpoint and metrics`. Subject under 72 chars, include ticket ID in body.

kai: Pre-commit flagged isort/ruff changes. Should I push them as a separate commit?

ana: Yes — `chore(format): apply isort/ruff` is ideal so reviewers can ignore formatting. Run `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files`. We also have `make dev` to spin things locally.

tj: CI gates: lint, unit, typecheck, integration. If integration fails intermittently, add label `ci-flake` and paste the job URL.

kai: What's our force-push etiquette? I rebased to resolve conflicts.

ana: Use `--force-with-lease`. Force-pushes before review are fine. Once reviewers are added, avoid history rewrites; if you must, call it out and re-request review.

pr-bot: tip: comment `@pr-bot request-review` to re-trigger reviewers after a push.

kai: Do we have an auto-merge policy?

tj: Merge queue will pick up PRs labeled `ready` with green CI and no blocking reviews. Sensitive areas (infra, public-api) need explicit approval. If you need expedited merge, add `priority/fast` and ping @tj.

kai: Anything else reviewers want in the PR body?

ana: Short checklist works: What/Why, How to run locally (commands + sample payload), Tests added, Rollback plan (feature flag or revert), and Impact (DB/config). Example snippet for testing: `curl -X GET localhost:8080/health` and `make test -k test_health`.

kai: Awesome—I'll tidy formatting into its own commit, add the checklist, run pre-commit, and mark ready. Thanks! :pray:
